<html lang="ca">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#24506a">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Psiquia 1P">
<title>Psiquia 1P</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Familjen+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&display=swap">
<style>
html,body{margin:0}body{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}:root{padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* Layout: password gate over the brain photo; then a hub with two sections (exams / notes); one narrow column app */
:root{
  --img:url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --bg:#eef3f6; --surface:#ffffff; --ink:#152a36; --muted:#56707f; --line:#d3dee5;
  --brand:#24506a; --brand-ink:#ffffff;
  --accent:#e8b21c; --accent-ink:#1d1704; --accent-soft:#fbf0cc;
  --pink:#c94a83; --pink-soft:#fbe3ee;
  --ok:#1f7a4d; --ok-soft:#dff2e6; --bad:#c0392b; --bad-soft:#f9e1de; --warn:#8a5a00; --warn-soft:#fdf0cf;
  --f-display:"Familjen Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif; --f-body:"Atkinson Hyperlegible",system-ui,sans-serif; --f-mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;
  --sec:var(--brand); --sec-soft:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand) 12%,var(--surface));
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:#0d1820; --surface:#142330; --ink:#e3edf2; --muted:#93a8b5; --line:#263a48;
  --brand:#8cc3df; --brand-ink:#0d1820; --accent:#f0c240; --accent-ink:#1d1704; --accent-soft:#3a3013;
  --pink:#f08ab6; --pink-soft:#3a1d2a;
  --ok:#5fcf93; --ok-soft:#173326; --bad:#f08178; --bad-soft:#3a1d1a; --warn:#f0c46a; --warn-soft:#3a2f14; color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0d1820; --surface:#142330; --ink:#e3edf2; --muted:#93a8b5; --line:#263a48;
  --brand:#8cc3df; --brand-ink:#0d1820; --accent:#f0c240; --accent-ink:#1d1704; --accent-soft:#3a3013;
  --pink:#f08ab6; --pink-soft:#3a1d2a;
  --ok:#5fcf93; --ok-soft:#173326; --bad:#f08178; --bad-soft:#3a1d1a; --warn:#f0c46a; --warn-soft:#3a2f14; color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{min-height:100%}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5}
.sec-exam{--sec:var(--brand);--sec-soft:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand) 12%,var(--surface))}
.sec-apunts{--sec:var(--pink);--sec-soft:var(--pink-soft)}
.wrap{max-width:740px;margin:0 auto;padding-block:20px 60px;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--f-display);text-wrap:balance;margin:0;line-height:1.12}
h1{font-size:2.1rem;letter-spacing:-.015em}
h2{font-size:1.15rem}
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
p{margin:0}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.panel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 16px;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:600}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.small{padding:6px 10px;font-size:.85rem}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}

/* ---------- gate (deliberately single look: the photo's blue) ---------- */
.gate{min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,400px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4f7f9a 0%,#7ab2cb 100%);padding-block:32px;padding-left:max(32px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));color:#152a36}
.gate-img{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;width:100%;max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:var(--img) center/cover no-repeat;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 50% 50%,#000 62%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 50% 50%,#000 62%,transparent 100%)}
.gate-card{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;position:relative;z-index:1}
.gate-card{width:min(400px,100%);background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);border-radius:20px;padding:28px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(17,42,58,.28)}
.gate-card .eyebrow{color:#4c6878}
.gate-card h1{font-size:2.6rem;color:#152a36}
.gate-card h1 span{color:#c94a83}
.gate-card p.lead{color:#3d5866}
.wires{display:flex;gap:5px}
.wires i{height:4px;flex:1;border-radius:2px}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.field label{font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem}
.pwrow{display:flex;gap:8px}
.pwrow input{flex:1;min-width:0;font:inherit;font-size:1.05rem;padding:11px 12px;border:1.5px solid #b9cbd6;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#152a36}
.pwrow input:focus{border-color:#24506a;outline:none}
.gate .btn.primary{background:#e8b21c;border-color:#e8b21c;color:#1d1704;padding:12px 18px}
.gate .tg{color:#2c4553}
.gate .tg input{accent-color:#24506a}
.err{color:#b4372f;font-weight:700;min-height:1.5em;font-size:.92rem}
.gate small{color:#4c6878;font-size:.82rem}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .gate{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:0;align-items:start;padding-block:0 32px;padding-left:0;padding-right:0}
  .gate-img{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;aspect-ratio:16/10;background-position:58% 50%;-webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none}
  .gate-card{grid-row:2}
  .gate-card{grid-column:1;margin:-40px auto 0;width:calc(100% - 2*max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)))}
}

/* ---------- hub ---------- */
.topbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.brandmark{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem}
.brandmark span{color:var(--pink)}
.strip{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/6;max-width:100%;border-radius:18px;background:#6a9fbe var(--img) 60% 48%/cover no-repeat;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:16px 18px}
.strip h1{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(10,30,45,.45);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,5vw,2.2rem)}
.deck{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:14px}
.sec-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;text-align:left;background:var(--surface);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;min-width:0;transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s}
.sec-card:hover{border-color:var(--sec);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.sec-card .count{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:700;font-size:3rem;line-height:1;color:var(--sec);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.sec-card .count small{font-size:1rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-left:6px}
.sec-card h2{font-size:1.35rem}
.sec-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.sec-card .go{margin-top:auto;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:700;color:var(--sec)}
.prog2{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted)}
.bar{height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--sec)}
details.panel summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
details.panel[open] summary{margin-bottom:10px}
details.panel p,details.panel li{font-size:.92rem}
details.panel ul{margin:0;padding-left:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}

/* ---------- section ---------- */
.sechead{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.sechead h1{color:var(--sec)}
.tabs{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:6px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:5px}
.tabs button{border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 4px;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--muted)}
.tabs button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--sec);color:var(--surface)}
.seg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;flex-wrap:wrap}
.seg button{border:0;background:var(--surface);padding:7px 12px;font-size:.88rem;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--sec-soft);color:var(--sec)}
.chips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:8px}
.chip{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;min-width:0}
.chip .code{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);min-width:2.6em;padding-top:2px}
.chip .nm{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.3}
.chip .meta{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-top:3px}
.chip .bar{margin-top:6px;height:4px}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--sec);background:var(--sec-soft)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] .code{color:var(--sec)}
.chip.off{border-style:dashed}
.yrs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:8px}
.toggles{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.tg{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.95rem}
.tg input{margin-top:4px;accent-color:var(--sec);width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
.num{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.num input{width:80px;font:inherit;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.startbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ---------- test ---------- */
.top{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:5;background:var(--bg);padding-block:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:16px}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:var(--bg)}
.top .row{justify-content:space-between}
.prog{height:6px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}
.prog i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--sec);transition:width .2s}
.score{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.85rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.score .o{color:var(--ok)} .score .x{color:var(--bad)}
.ref{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.tag{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.72rem;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);background:var(--surface)}
.tag.sec{border-color:var(--sec);color:var(--sec)}
.stem{font-size:1.12rem;line-height:1.5}
.opts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.opt{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;width:100%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;line-height:1.4}
.opt .l{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-weight:500;width:26px;height:26px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.85rem}
.opt span.t{min-width:0;padding-top:2px}
.opt:not(:disabled):hover{border-color:var(--sec)}
.opt:disabled{cursor:default}
.opt.ok{border-color:var(--ok);background:var(--ok-soft)} .opt.ok .l{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok);color:var(--surface)}
.opt.bad{border-color:var(--bad);background:var(--bad-soft)} .opt.bad .l{background:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad);color:var(--surface)}
.opt.dim{opacity:.6}
.fb{border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);font-size:.95rem}
.fb.ok{border-color:var(--ok)} .fb.bad{border-color:var(--bad)}
.fb b.v{font-family:var(--f-display)}
.fb.ok b.v{color:var(--ok)} .fb.bad b.v{color:var(--bad)}
.fb p{margin-top:6px}
.src{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.7rem;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:2px}
.src.P{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--warn)} .src.O{background:var(--ok-soft);color:var(--ok)} .src.M{background:var(--warn-soft);color:var(--warn)}
.src.C,.src.A{background:var(--pink-soft);color:var(--pink)}
.warnnote{background:var(--warn-soft);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin-top:8px}
.nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.kbd{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted)}
/* results */
.big{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:3.2rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--sec)}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:12px}
.kpi .k{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.92rem}
td,th{padding:7px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
th{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
td.n{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}
.rev{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.rev .item{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bad-soft)}
.rev .item p{margin:4px 0}
.legend p{margin:4px 0}
@media (max-width:480px){h1{font-size:1.7rem}.tabs button{font-size:.85rem}.stem{font-size:1.05rem}.sec-card .count{font-size:2.5rem}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.prog i,.sec-card{transition:none}.sec-card:hover{transform:none}}
</style>

</head>
<body>
<div id="app"></div>

<script id="enc" type="application/json">{"salt":"Ku6QT5CQwO+/rAFZ3kpuOQ==","it":3000,"chk":"b6e0dede26539b9f","ct":""}</script>
<script>
const ENC = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('enc').textContent);
const PWKEY = 'psiquia1p.pw', SKEY = 'psiquia1p.v1';
const $ = (s, el=document) => el.querySelector(s);
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const app = $('#app');
const ls = {get(k){try{return localStorage.getItem(k)}catch(e){return null}}, set(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){}}, del(k){try{localStorage.removeItem(k)}catch(e){}}};

/* Pure-JS SHA-256 keystream cipher: works in any browser, also from a local file, no external libraries */
function sha256(m){
  const K=[0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2];
  const H=[0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19];
  const l=m.length, n=((l+9+63)>>6)<<6, b=new Uint8Array(n); b.set(m); b[l]=0x80;
  const bits=l*8; b[n-4]=bits>>>24; b[n-3]=bits>>>16; b[n-2]=bits>>>8; b[n-1]=bits; b[n-5]=Math.floor(bits/4294967296);
  const w=new Uint32Array(64), r=(x,c)=>(x>>>c)|(x<<(32-c));
  for(let o=0;o<n;o+=64){
    for(let i=0;i<16;i++) w[i]=(b[o+4*i]<<24)|(b[o+4*i+1]<<16)|(b[o+4*i+2]<<8)|b[o+4*i+3];
    for(let i=16;i<64;i++){const s0=r(w[i-15],7)^r(w[i-15],18)^(w[i-15]>>>3), s1=r(w[i-2],17)^r(w[i-2],19)^(w[i-2]>>>10); w[i]=(w[i-16]+s0+w[i-7]+s1)|0;}
    let [a,bb,c,d,e,f,g,h]=H;
    for(let i=0;i<64;i++){const t1=(h+(r(e,6)^r(e,11)^r(e,25))+((e&f)^(~e&g))+K[i]+w[i])|0, t2=((r(a,2)^r(a,13)^r(a,22))+((a&bb)^(a&c)^(bb&c)))|0; h=g;g=f;f=e;e=(d+t1)|0;d=c;c=bb;bb=a;a=(t1+t2)|0;}
    H[0]=(H[0]+a)|0;H[1]=(H[1]+bb)|0;H[2]=(H[2]+c)|0;H[3]=(H[3]+d)|0;H[4]=(H[4]+e)|0;H[5]=(H[5]+f)|0;H[6]=(H[6]+g)|0;H[7]=(H[7]+h)|0;
  }
  const out=new Uint8Array(32); H.forEach((v,i)=>{out[4*i]=v>>>24;out[4*i+1]=v>>>16;out[4*i+2]=v>>>8;out[4*i+3]=v;}); return out;
}
const cat=(...a)=>{const o=new Uint8Array(a.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.length,0));let p=0;a.forEach(x=>{o.set(x,p);p+=x.length});return o;};
const utf8=s=>{const e=unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)),o=new Uint8Array(e.length);for(let i=0;i<e.length;i++)o[i]=e.charCodeAt(i);return o;};
const b64=s=>{const t=atob(s),o=new Uint8Array(t.length);for(let i=0;i<t.length;i++)o[i]=t.charCodeAt(i);return o;};
async function decrypt(pw){
  const salt=b64(ENC.salt); let k=cat(salt,utf8(pw));
  for(let i=0;i<ENC.it;i++) k=sha256(cat(k,salt));
  const chk=sha256(cat(k,utf8('check')));
  if (Array.from(chk.slice(0,8)).map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')!==ENC.chk) throw new Error('pw');
  const ct=b64(ENC.ct), pt=new Uint8Array(ct.length), ctr=new Uint8Array(4);
  for(let o=0,blk=0;o<ct.length;o+=32,blk++){
    ctr[0]=blk>>>24;ctr[1]=blk>>>16;ctr[2]=blk>>>8;ctr[3]=blk;
    const ks=sha256(cat(k,ctr));
    for(let j=0;j<32&&o+j<ct.length;j++) pt[o+j]=ct[o+j]^ks[j];
  }
  let s=''; for(let i=0;i<pt.length;i+=8192) s+=String.fromCharCode.apply(null,pt.subarray(i,i+8192));
  return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(s)));
}
const norm = s => s.trim().toLowerCase();

let TEM, QS, BYID, ORDER_T, store, T = null, SEC = null;
const SRCN = {P:'plantilla 2024', O:'clau oficial', M:'resposta proposada', C:'test de la comissió', A:'pregunta dels apunts'};
const REF = q => q.y==='Apunts' ? (q.s==='C' ? 'Comissió · ' : 'Apunts · ') + q.t : q.y + ' · P' + q.n;
const SECS = {
  exam:   {name:'Exàmens', cls:'sec-exam'},
  apunts: {name:'Apunts', cls:'sec-apunts'}
};
const pool = sec => QS.filter(q => sec==='apunts' ? q.y==='Apunts' : q.y!=='Apunts');
const save = () => ls.set(SKEY, JSON.stringify(store));
function shuffle(a){ a=a.slice(); for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];} return a; }

function boot(data){
  TEM = data.temes; QS = data.qs;
  QS.forEach(q => q.id = q.y + '#' + q.n);
  BYID = Object.fromEntries(QS.map(q => [q.id, q]));
  ORDER_T = Object.keys(TEM);
  try { store = JSON.parse(ls.get(SKEY)) || {}; } catch(e){ store = {}; }
  store.h = store.h || {};
  const T18 = ORDER_T.filter(t => /^T\d+$/.test(t));
  store.opt = Object.assign({shuffle:true, penal:true}, store.opt || {});
  store.sec = store.sec || {};
  store.sec.exam = Object.assign({tab:'temes', temes:T18, years:['2024'], n:30, fora:false}, store.sec.exam || {});
  store.sec.apunts = Object.assign({tab:'temes', temes:T18, n:30, src:'all'}, store.sec.apunts || {});
  if (!store.sec.apunts.t18){ store.sec.apunts.t18 = 1; if (!store.sec.apunts.temes.includes('T18')) store.sec.apunts.temes.push('T18'); }
  save(); hub();
}

/* ---------- GATE ---------- */
function gate(msg=''){
  T = null; SEC = null; document.body.className = '';
  app.innerHTML = `<div class="gate">
    <div class="gate-img" role="img" aria-label="Cervell amb cables de colors"></div>
    <form class="gate-card" id="gf" autocomplete="off">
      <div class="wires" aria-hidden="true"><i style="background:#3fa0d8"></i><i style="background:#e8b21c"></i><i style="background:#d8352a"></i><i style="background:#3c9a4a"></i><i style="background:#e2649b"></i></div>
      <span class="eyebrow">Psiquiatria · 1r parcial · Parc Taulí–UAB</span>
      <h1>Psiquia <span>1P</span></h1>
      <p class="lead">Preguntes d'exàmens i dels apunts, amb correcció al moment.</p>
      <div class="field"><label for="pw">Contrasenya</label>
        <div class="pwrow"><input id="pw" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required></div></div>
      <label class="tg"><input type="checkbox" id="rem" checked> Recorda-la en aquest dispositiu</label>
      <button class="btn primary" id="enter" type="submit">Entra</button>
      <div class="err" id="err" role="alert">${esc(msg)}</div>
      <small>Els resultats es guarden només al navegador de cada dispositiu.</small>
    </form></div>`;
  $('#gf').onsubmit = async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pw = norm($('#pw').value); const btn = $('#enter');
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Obrint…'; $('#err').textContent = '';
    try { const data = await decrypt(pw); if ($('#rem').checked) ls.set(PWKEY, pw); else ls.del(PWKEY); boot(data); }
    catch(err){ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Entra'; $('#err').textContent = err && err.message==='pw' ? 'Contrasenya incorrecta. Torna-ho a provar.' : 'No s\'ha pogut obrir el test en aquest navegador. Prova-ho amb Chrome o Safari actualitzats.'; $('#pw').select(); }
  };
  setTimeout(() => { const i = $('#pw'); if (i) i.focus(); }, 50);
}

/* ---------- HUB ---------- */
function secStats(sec){
  const list = pool(sec), seen = list.filter(q => store.h[q.id]);
  const ok = seen.filter(q => store.h[q.id].last==='ok').length;
  return {n:list.length, seen:seen.length, ok};
}
function hub(){
  T = null; SEC = null; document.body.className = ''; window.scrollTo(0,0);
  const card = (sec, eyebrow, desc) => { const s = secStats(sec);
    return `<button class="sec-card ${SECS[sec].cls}" data-sec="${sec}">
      <span class="eyebrow">${eyebrow}</span>
      <div class="count">${s.n}<small>preguntes</small></div>
      <h2>${SECS[sec].name}</h2>
      <p>${desc}</p>
      <div class="prog2"><span>${s.seen ? `${s.seen} fetes · ${Math.round(100*s.ok/s.seen)}% bé l'última vegada` : 'Encara no n\'has fet cap'}</span>
        <div class="bar"><i style="width:${100*s.seen/s.n}%"></i></div></div>
      <span class="go">Entra →</span></button>`; };
  const ap = pool('apunts');
  app.innerHTML = `<div class="wrap stack">
    <div class="topbar"><span class="brandmark">Psiquia <span>1P</span></span><button class="btn small ghost" id="logout">Tanca la sessió</button></div>
    <div class="strip" role="img" aria-label="Cervell amb cables de colors"><h1>Què vols practicar?</h1></div>
    <div class="deck">
      ${card('exam', 'Exàmens 2010 – 2024', "Preguntes reals d'examen, per temes o per any. Respostes de la plantilla 2024, la clau oficial 2016-17 o proposades a partir dels apunts.")}
      ${card('apunts', 'Temes 1 – 18', `Test de la comissió (${ap.filter(q=>q.s==='C').length}) i preguntes noves (${ap.filter(q=>q.s==='A').length}) redactades a partir dels apunts, amb l'explicació de cada resposta.`)}
    </div>
    <details class="panel"><summary>Instal·la-la al mòbil</summary><ul>
      <li><b>iPhone o iPad:</b> obre-la amb Safari, toca Compartir i tria «Afegir a la pantalla d'inici».</li>
      <li><b>Android:</b> obre-la amb Chrome, toca el menú ⋮ i tria «Afegir a la pantalla d'inici».</li></ul></details>
    <details class="panel"><summary>El meu progrés</summary>
      <p>Tens ${Object.keys(store.h).length} preguntes respostes guardades en aquest dispositiu.</p>
      <p style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn small" id="reset">Esborra el meu progrés</button> <span id="resetc"></span></p></details>
  </div>`;
  app.querySelectorAll('[data-sec]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => section(b.dataset.sec));
  $('#logout').onclick = () => { ls.del(PWKEY); gate(); };
  $('#reset').onclick = () => { $('#resetc').innerHTML = '<button class="btn small" id="reset2">Sí, esborra-ho</button>'; $('#reset2').onclick = () => { store.h = {}; save(); hub(); }; };
}

/* ---------- SECTION ---------- */
function qsFor(sec, c){
  let base = pool(sec);
  const fora = t => t==='X' || t==='ANS';
  if (c.tab==='errors') return base.filter(q => store.h[q.id] && store.h[q.id].last==='ko');
  if (sec==='apunts' && c.src!=='all') base = base.filter(q => q.s===c.src);
  if (c.tab==='temes') return base.filter(q => c.temes.includes(q.t));
  if (c.tab==='anys') return base.filter(q => c.years.includes(q.y) && (c.fora || !fora(q.t)));
  return base.filter(q => sec==='apunts' || c.fora || !fora(q.t));
}
function section(sec){
  SEC = sec; T = null; document.body.className = SECS[sec].cls; window.scrollTo(0,0);
  const c = store.sec[sec], P = pool(sec);
  const tabs = sec==='exam' ? [['temes','Per temes'],['anys','Per examen'],['mix','Barreja'],['errors','Errors']] : [['temes','Per temes'],['mix','Barreja'],['errors','Errors']];
  if (!tabs.some(t => t[0]===c.tab)) c.tab = 'temes';
  const temes = ORDER_T.filter(t => P.some(q => q.t===t));
  const tStat = t => { const l = P.filter(q => q.t===t), s = l.filter(q => store.h[q.id]); return {n:l.length, seen:s.length, ok:s.filter(q => store.h[q.id].last==='ok').length}; };
  const srcSeg = sec==='apunts' && c.tab!=='errors' ? `<div class="row"><span class="muted" style="font-size:.9rem">Origen:</span><div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Origen de les preguntes">
      ${[['all','Totes'],['C','Comissió'],['A','Noves']].map(([k,l]) => `<button aria-pressed="${c.src===k}" data-src="${k}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>` : '';
  let body = '';
  if (c.tab==='temes'){
    const main = temes.filter(t => /^T\d+$/.test(t));
    body = `<div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between"><h2>Tria temes</h2>
      <div class="row"><button class="btn small" data-act="all">Tots</button><button class="btn small" data-act="none">Cap</button></div></div>${srcSeg}
      <div class="chips">${temes.map(t => { const s = tStat(t), on = c.temes.includes(t);
        return `<button class="chip ${/^T\d+$/.test(t)?'':'off'}" aria-pressed="${on}" data-t="${t}">
          <span class="code">${/^T\d+$/.test(t) ? t : t==='ANS' ? 'ANS' : '—'}</span><span class="nm">${esc(TEM[t])}
          <span class="meta">${s.n} preg.${s.seen ? ` · ${s.ok}/${s.seen} bé` : ''}</span>
          ${s.seen ? `<span class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.round(100*s.ok/s.n)}%"></i></span>` : ''}</span></button>`; }).join('')}</div>
      ${sec==='exam' ? `<p class="muted" style="font-size:.88rem">Ansietat i «altres temes» són preguntes de finals antics que no entren al 1r parcial.</p>` : ''}`;
    c._main = main;
  } else if (c.tab==='anys'){
    const yrs = [...new Set(P.map(q => q.y))];
    body = `<h2>Tria examen</h2><div class="yrs">${yrs.map(y => { const n = P.filter(q => q.y===y).length, on = c.years.includes(y);
      return `<button class="chip" aria-pressed="${on}" data-y="${y}"><span class="nm"><b>${y}</b><span class="meta">${n} preg.${y==='2014'?' · final':''}${y==='2024'?' · plantilla':''}</span></span></button>`; }).join('')}</div>
      <label class="tg"><input type="checkbox" id="fora" ${c.fora?'checked':''}> Inclou temes que no entren (ansietat, personalitat, TCA…)</label>`;
  } else if (c.tab==='mix'){
    body = `<h2>Barreja</h2>${srcSeg}
      <div class="num"><label for="nq">Nombre de preguntes</label><input type="number" id="nq" min="5" max="300" value="${c.n}"></div>
      ${sec==='exam' ? `<label class="tg"><input type="checkbox" id="fora" ${c.fora?'checked':''}> Inclou temes que no entren</label>` : ''}`;
  } else {
    const n = qsFor(sec, c).length;
    body = `<h2>Repassa les que has fallat</h2><p>${n ? `Tens <b>${n}</b> preguntes d'aquesta secció on l'última resposta va ser incorrecta. Quan les encertis, surten de la llista.` : 'Encara no tens errors guardats en aquesta secció.'}</p>`;
  }
  const list = qsFor(sec, c), count = c.tab==='mix' ? Math.min(c.n, list.length) : list.length;
  const legend = sec==='exam'
    ? `<p><span class="src P">plantilla 2024</span> full de respostes de l'examen del 2024.</p><p><span class="src O">clau oficial</span> respostes que venien al document (2016-17).</p><p><span class="src M">resposta proposada</span> raonada a partir dels apunts; no és oficial. Les marcades amb ⚠️ són dubtoses.</p><p>Falten les preguntes 31–40 del 2024 i les preguntes curtes.</p>`
    : `<p><span class="src C">test de la comissió</span> preguntes que venien al final dels apunts, amb la seva resposta.</p><p><span class="src A">pregunta dels apunts</span> preguntes noves redactades a partir dels apunts, amb l'explicació.</p>`;
  app.innerHTML = `<div class="wrap stack">
    <div class="topbar"><button class="btn small ghost" id="back">← Inici</button><span class="brandmark">Psiquia <span>1P</span></span></div>
    <header class="sechead"><span class="eyebrow">${sec==='exam' ? 'Exàmens 2010 – 2024' : 'Preguntes dels apunts · T1 – T18'}</span><h1>${SECS[sec].name}</h1></header>
    <div class="tabs" role="tablist">${tabs.map(([k,l]) => `<button role="tab" aria-selected="${c.tab===k}" data-tab="${k}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <section class="panel stack">${body}</section>
    <section class="panel toggles">
      <label class="tg"><input type="checkbox" id="shuffle" ${store.opt.shuffle?'checked':''}> Ordre aleatori de les preguntes</label>
      <label class="tg"><input type="checkbox" id="penal" ${store.opt.penal?'checked':''}> Nota amb penalització (cada error resta 1/(opcions−1))</label>
    </section>
    <div class="startbar"><span class="muted">${count} preguntes seleccionades</span><button class="btn primary" id="go" ${count?'':'disabled'}>Comença el test</button></div>
    <details class="panel legend"><summary>D'on surten les respostes</summary>${legend}</details>
  </div>`;
  const re = () => { save(); section(sec); };
  $('#back').onclick = hub;
  app.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { c.tab = b.dataset.tab; re(); });
  app.querySelectorAll('[data-src]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { c.src = b.dataset.src; re(); });
  app.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const t = b.dataset.t; c.temes = c.temes.includes(t) ? c.temes.filter(x => x!==t) : [...c.temes, t]; re(); });
  app.querySelectorAll('[data-y]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const y = b.dataset.y; c.years = c.years.includes(y) ? c.years.filter(x => x!==y) : [...c.years, y]; re(); });
  const a = $('[data-act="all"]'); if (a){ a.onclick = () => { c.temes = temes.filter(t => /^T\d+$/.test(t)); re(); }; $('[data-act="none"]').onclick = () => { c.temes = []; re(); }; }
  const f = $('#fora'); if (f) f.onchange = () => { c.fora = f.checked; re(); };
  const nq = $('#nq'); if (nq) nq.onchange = () => { c.n = Math.max(5, Math.min(300, +nq.value || 30)); re(); };
  $('#shuffle').onchange = e => { store.opt.shuffle = e.target.checked; save(); };
  $('#penal').onchange = e => { store.opt.penal = e.target.checked; save(); };
  $('#go').onclick = () => { let l = qsFor(sec, c); if (store.opt.shuffle || c.tab==='mix') l = shuffle(l); if (c.tab==='mix') l = l.slice(0, count); start(l); };
}

/* ---------- TEST ---------- */
function start(list){ T = {list:list.map(q => q.id), i:0, ans:{}}; window.scrollTo(0,0); question(); }
function tally(){
  let ok=0, ko=0, bl=0, pen=0;
  for (const id of T.list){ const a = T.ans[id]; if (a===undefined) continue; const q = BYID[id];
    if (a===null) bl++; else if (a===q.a) ok++; else { ko++; pen += 1/(q.o.length-1); } }
  return {ok, ko, bl, pen};
}
function question(){
  const id = T.list[T.i], q = BYID[id], a = T.ans[id], done = a!==undefined, t = tally(), n = T.list.length;
  const opts = q.o.map(([l, txt]) => { let cls = '';
    if (done){ cls = l===q.a ? 'ok' : l===a ? 'bad' : 'dim'; }
    return `<button class="opt ${cls}" data-l="${l}" ${done?'disabled':''}><span class="l">${l}</span><span class="t">${esc(txt)}</span></button>`; }).join('');
  let fb = '';
  if (done){
    const st = a===null ? 'blank' : a===q.a ? 'ok' : 'bad';
    const verdict = st==='ok' ? 'Correcte' : st==='bad' ? `Incorrecte · era la ${q.a}` : `En blanc · era la ${q.a}`;
    const note = q.nt ? (q.nt.includes('⚠') ? `<div class="warnnote">${esc(q.nt)}</div>` : `<p>${esc(q.nt)}</p>`) : '';
    fb = `<div class="fb ${st}" role="status"><b class="v">${verdict}</b><span class="src ${q.s}">${SRCN[q.s]}</span>${note}</div>`;
  }
  app.innerHTML = `<div class="wrap"><div class="top"><div class="row">
      <button class="btn small" id="exit">← Surt</button>
      <span class="score"><span class="o">✓ ${t.ok}</span> · <span class="x">✗ ${t.ko}</span> · ${T.i+1}/${n}</span>
      <button class="btn small" id="end">Acaba</button></div>
      <div class="prog"><i style="width:${100*Object.keys(T.ans).length/n}%"></i></div></div>
    <div class="stack">
      <div class="ref"><span class="tag sec">${esc(REF(q))}</span><span class="tag">${esc(TEM[q.t])}</span></div>
      <p class="stem">${esc(q.q)}</p>
      <div class="opts">${opts}</div>
      ${fb}
      <div class="nav"><button class="btn" id="prev" ${T.i?'':'disabled'}>Anterior</button>
        ${done ? '' : '<button class="btn" id="skip">No ho sé</button>'}
        <button class="btn ${done?'primary':''}" id="next">${T.i===n-1 ? 'Resultats' : 'Següent'}</button></div>
      <span class="kbd">Teclat: a–f per respondre · Enter o → per avançar · ← per tornar</span>
    </div></div>`;
  app.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => answer(b.dataset.l));
  $('#prev').onclick = () => go(-1); $('#next').onclick = () => go(1);
  const sk = $('#skip'); if (sk) sk.onclick = () => answer(null);
  $('#exit').onclick = () => section(SEC); $('#end').onclick = results;
}
function answer(l){
  const id = T.list[T.i], q = BYID[id];
  if (T.ans[id]!==undefined) return;
  T.ans[id] = l;
  if (l!==null){ const h = store.h[id] || {ok:0, ko:0}; if (l===q.a){ h.ok++; h.last='ok'; } else { h.ko++; h.last='ko'; } store.h[id] = h; save(); }
  question();
}
function go(d){ const n = T.list.length; if (d>0 && T.i===n-1) return results(); T.i = Math.max(0, Math.min(n-1, T.i+d)); question(); window.scrollTo(0,0); }
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (!T || $('#res') || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (/^[a-f]$/.test(k)){ const b = $(`.opt[data-l="${k}"]`); if (b && !b.disabled){ e.preventDefault(); answer(k); } }
  else if (k==='enter' || k==='arrowright'){ if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.classList.contains('opt')) return; e.preventDefault(); go(1); }
  else if (k==='arrowleft'){ e.preventDefault(); go(-1); }
});

/* ---------- RESULTS ---------- */
function results(){
  const n = T.list.length, t = tally(), answered = t.ok+t.ko+t.bl;
  const nota = Math.max(0, 10*(t.ok - (store.opt.penal ? t.pen : 0))/n);
  const byT = {};
  for (const id of T.list){ const q = BYID[id], a = T.ans[id], r = byT[q.t] = byT[q.t] || {n:0, ok:0, ko:0}; r.n++; if (a===q.a) r.ok++; else if (a!==undefined && a!==null) r.ko++; }
  const wrong = T.list.filter(id => { const a = T.ans[id]; return a!==undefined && a!==BYID[id].a; });
  app.innerHTML = `<div class="wrap stack" id="res">
    <div class="topbar"><button class="btn small ghost" id="home2">← ${SECS[SEC].name}</button><span class="brandmark">Psiquia <span>1P</span></span></div>
    <header class="sechead"><span class="eyebrow">Resultat · ${SECS[SEC].name}</span><h1>${t.ok} de ${n} correctes</h1></header>
    <section class="panel kpis">
      <div class="kpi"><div class="big">${nota.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</div><span class="muted">nota sobre 10${store.opt.penal ? ' amb penalització' : ''}</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><div class="k" style="color:var(--ok)">${t.ok}</div><span class="muted">encerts</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><div class="k" style="color:var(--bad)">${t.ko}</div><span class="muted">errors</span></div>
      <div class="kpi"><div class="k">${t.bl + (n-answered)}</div><span class="muted">en blanc o sense fer</span></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel stack"><h2>Per tema</h2><div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Tema</th><th class="n">Bé</th><th class="n">Malament</th><th class="n">Total</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      ${ORDER_T.filter(x => byT[x]).map(x => `<tr><td>${/^T\d+$/.test(x) ? x+' · ' : ''}${esc(TEM[x])}</td><td class="n">${byT[x].ok}</td><td class="n">${byT[x].ko}</td><td class="n">${byT[x].n}</td></tr>`).join('')}
    </tbody></table></div></section>
    <div class="row"><button class="btn primary" id="again" ${wrong.length ? '' : 'disabled'}>Repeteix les ${wrong.length} fallades</button><button class="btn" id="home">Torna a ${SECS[SEC].name}</button></div>
    ${wrong.length ? `<section class="panel stack"><h2>Repàs</h2><div class="rev">${wrong.map(id => { const q = BYID[id], a = T.ans[id], oa = q.o.find(o => o[0]===q.a), ya = a && q.o.find(o => o[0]===a);
      return `<div class="item"><span class="tag">${esc(REF(q))}</span><p><b>${esc(q.q)}</b></p>
        ${ya ? `<p style="color:var(--bad)">✗ ${a}. ${esc(ya[1])}</p>` : ''}
        <p style="color:var(--ok)">✓ ${q.a}. ${esc(oa[1])} <span class="src ${q.s}">${SRCN[q.s]}</span></p>
        ${q.nt ? `<p class="muted">${esc(q.nt)}</p>` : ''}</div>`; }).join('')}</div></section>` : ''}
  </div>`;
  $('#home').onclick = () => section(SEC); $('#home2').onclick = () => section(SEC);
  $('#again').onclick = () => start(shuffle(wrong.map(id => BYID[id])));
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

/* ---------- start ---------- */
(async () => {
  const saved = ls.get(PWKEY);
  if (saved){ try { boot(await decrypt(saved)); return; } catch(e){ ls.del(PWKEY); } }
  gate();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
